isConfigSupported(config)
Returns a promise indicating whether the provided |config| is supported by the User Agent. NOTE: The returned {{VideoEncoderSupport}} {{VideoEncoderSupport/config}} will contain only the dictionary members that User Agent recognized. Unrecognized dictionary members will be ignored. Authors can detect unrecognized dictionary members by comparing {{VideoEncoderSupport/config}} to their provided |config|. When invoked, run these steps: 1. If |config| is not a valid VideoEncoderConfig, return [=a promise rejected with=] {{TypeError}}.
